result.limits: Optimistic fixed-workload TS observation, not a mathematical lower bound or universal JS impossibility result. Raw bound/split read flat decoded bytes/numbers and hash every text row. Native wide consumes the original decoded dictionary segments, hashes/maps all entries and translates every row within timing, then uses packed five-AVG state. No precomputed canonical IDs/ranks. All use exact collision equality. Highcard native includes an exact full-input min/max probe and direct-address COUNT/SUM state with an exact general-hash fallback for a wide domain; highcard split and both other DISTINCT kernels alias bound (not independent algorithms). Operator keeps original scan dictionary forms and includes matching sort/top-N, copying and governor/driver/task clock. Whole is prepared pipeline/owned frames; outer harness separately measures SQL through cleanup. Feed is scan/project/discard only, not additive with the other sinks. Setup/flattening (including numeric widening to Float64) excluded; kernel allocation/state/final ordering included. Borrowed immutable inputs need no key copy; no memory governor/spill/cancellation in plain TS. AVG Sxx retained. Plain kernels are diagnostics; operator/candidate configurations are reported separately.

Specialized reusable numeric/type family and bounded all-valid finite prefix; different shapes/promoted states use general accumulators. Uncertified distributions may lose former packed-bank performance; only the reported catalogue workload is qualified.
No runtime code generation, approximate arithmetic, Sxx skip, new spill support, stored-format or public API changes. All state, translation growth and restoration scratch remain charged.
